# Harbor

## Colors

Amber is the brand. Primary buttons are amber with white labels. Body text is on-surface on the surface; secondary text is on-surface-variant.

Captions and timestamps use a lighter gray, #9ca3af, on the surface so they recede.

Error text is error red on the surface.

## Dark mode

Not designed yet. Invert the palette for now.

## Components

Cards use 20px padding and the md radius.

Focus is a 1px outline in the outline color.

Hover darkens each button's own color by 10%.
